description: This file contains utility methods related to SMS and device version checks for an Android app, including methods to determine Android version and default SMS application status, as well as prompting the user to change default SMS app.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to handle SMS app status and Android version checks.

methods.name: hasJellyBeanMR2
methods.description: Checks if the device runs Android 4.3 (Jelly Bean MR2) or higher.

methods.name: hasKitKat
methods.description: Checks if the device runs Android 4.4 (KitKat) or higher.

methods.name: isDefaultSmsApp
methods.description: Determines if the current app is set as the default system SMS app; always returns true on pre-KitKat devices.

methods.name: setDefaultSmsApp
methods.description: Initiates an intent to prompt the user to change the default SMS application on KitKat and above.
